title: plan
description: The ticket graph of phase P4 (Implementation Decisions 10, plan): what the planner returns in its plan protocol, and what research/plan.json keeps beside the ids it became. Tickets carry a key rather than an id, because code numbers them from the next free id when it writes tickets/NN-slug.md; a blocked_by or pauses entry is another ticket's key, or #<id> for a ticket the project already holds. The librarian assigns role and skills, so neither is here; status, proposed_by, and the ids are code's. The schema holds the shape; the plan-time Type-A checks of wayline.plan hold the rest (a DAG, every ticket with a demo, machine criteria, a touch set under the project, a context pack, a role, and skills, no criterion that passes at the base commit, a docs ticket after every code ticket that adds public API), so a plan that fails them is returned to the planner with the failures rather than refused as malformed.

tickets.description: the work tickets, in the order they are numbered; a decision ticket is never here, it is under decisions

key.description: the ticket's name inside this plan (T1, T2, ...), which blocked_by and pauses entries use

difficulty.description: by the rubric of BRIEF 8.4, which sets the model, the effort, and the budget

blocked_by.description: the tickets this one waits on: keys of this plan, or #<id> of tickets the project already holds

touches.description: the touch set: paths under the project the ticket may write, a directory with a trailing slash; never research/

resources.description: experiment and analysis tickets: what one job of the ticket needs, for the free-slot rule

machine.description: Type-A gates: shell commands run from the project root that must exit 0 once the ticket is done, and fail at the base commit

quality.description: Type-B gates: the question a verifier answers about the result, when the ticket needs a verdict

objectives.description: the open objectives (research/OBJECTIVES.md) the ticket serves; empty for one no objective asked for, a plotting ticket or one for an unasked claim

goal.description: when the ticket reports a goal's metric: the open objective with a measure it reports, whose metric and direction the measure gives

context_pack.description: the locators the worker is given, smallest first: a path, path:first-last, or path#heading

origin.description: what in the spec the ticket comes from, as a locator: research/SPEC.md#e1-claims-c1

demo.description: what a person would watch to believe the ticket is done

notes.description: free prose for the worker, written into the ticket body

adds_public_api.description: a code ticket that adds a function, a class, a command, or a file another ticket or a person calls; such a ticket is followed by a docs ticket

tags.description: what the ticket works with, which the librarian matches against the skills' applicability tags

retry.description: experiment tickets only: the footprint ladders of Implementation Decisions 6, each step spelled as a ticket file holds it, "--batch-size=16 NAME=value"

decisions.description: one decision ticket per choice the spec leaves open, with what it pauses

blocking.description: subgraph pauses the tickets it names and whatever waits on them; all pauses every ticket

human_only.description: true when the answer changes the goal or the data, or falls in a class the project lists under human_only

pauses.description: the tickets that wait for the answer: keys of this plan, or #<id> of tickets the project already holds

origin.description: what in the spec leaves the choice open, as a locator

notes.description: what the planner could not cut or had to take a side on: a kind no role covers, a choice taken with the recommended answer

reference.description: a key of this plan, or #<id> for a ticket the project already holds
